title: Data for: Semi-analytic Inference of Satellite Densities in the Cold Dark Matter Model (Parts I and II)
description:
Data accompanying the two-part paper series "Semi-analytic Inference of Satellite Densities in the Cold Dark Matter Model" (Part I: Comparison to Ultra-faint Dwarf Kinematics; Part II: Implications for Dark Matter Indirect Detection Constraints). The archives unpack at the root of the SatelliteDensityInference repository and support two reproduction tiers.

figures: regenerate every paper figure directly from intermediates (SatGen halo catalogs, seeded conditioning weights, the results/ products the figure manifests record, and a snapshot of the DwarfJeansAnalysis results).

inputs: the minimal inputs to recompute the paper results (SatGen halo catalogs, the published unseeded SHMR conditioning weights, Fermi-LAT data, and the DwarfJeansAnalysis results). SatGen merger trees are not included.

The SatGen catalogs archive also holds two reduced N-body comparison catalogs, from the Symphony (Nadler et al. 2023, ApJ 945, 159; Milky Way hosts from Mao, Williamson & Wechsler 2015) and Milky Way-est (Buch et al. 2024, ApJ 971, 79) suites. They are not covered by this record's CC BY 4.0 licence; cite those works and include the acknowledgement each suite requests (see README_DATA.md).

See README_DATA.md and MANIFEST.json (per-file sha256, producing commits) in the record, and use scripts/zenodo_fetch.py in the code repository to download and unpack.
